scope: Opt-in MCP PNG observations from native capture receipts
checks: PNG output independently decoded using the existing STB texture decoder.
Synthetic BMP layouts, orientation, mask gaps, color-profile rejection, alpha removal and malformed input.
Linear-light area reduction verified against equal black/white coverage.
MCP image options validated before dispatch; native receipts and exact operation parameters preserved.
Known observation failures retain the native result and are distinct from unknown transport outcomes.
Archived 640x480 SDL capture converted with every unscaled RGB pixel checked; no new GPU execution.
limits: Image receipt tests use a controlled backend; no actual Codex/Claude client image consumption is qualified.
Windows engine, desktop bridge and image/MCP test fixtures cross-compile; Windows runtime and current GPU captures remain unqualified.
The adapter runs with trusted local process file access and is not a filesystem isolation boundary.
